entries.head: traceql
entries.message: traceql: pipeline tail element %T is unsupported
entries.rationale: type-switch default: every pipeline-tail element type the pinned grammar produces is handled

guard: past exhaustive switch v := elem.(type) over [case traceql.Aggregate; case *traceql.Aggregate; case traceql.ScalarFilter; case *traceql.ScalarFilter; case traceql.SelectOperation; case *traceql.SelectOperation; case traceql.GroupOperation; case *traceql.GroupOperation; case traceql.CoalesceOperation; case *traceql.CoalesceOperation]
